reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004A8B37 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004A8B37-Camera_SetFieldOfView_15.cpp at sha256 e0a5502dd416bbaefb37fa1de36d488de3dad141831dd26413a3e4b733e445d3 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t __fastcall Camera_SetFieldOfView_15(int32_t param_1, void* param_2, void* param_3, long param_4, long param_5);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t __fastcall(int32_t arg1, void* arg2, void* arg3 @ ebp, long double arg4 @ st0, long double arg5 @ st1)" at 0x004A8B37; radare2 recovers "fcn.004a8b37 ();". Both tools place the entry at 0x004A8B37 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t __fastcall Camera_SetFieldOfView_15(int32_t param_1, void* param_2, void* param_3, long param_4, long param_5);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
